desc: Ideate approaches and select the frequency plus fast Walsh-Hadamard transform XOR convolution method.

Implement the complete solution: parse H, W, and grid rows into bitmasks; build freq of size 2^W; build cost[m] = min(popcount(m), W - popcount(m)); perform FWHT XOR convolution; take the minimum convolution value as the answer.
Optimize the Python implementation for W up to 18, including efficient popcount, in-place FWHT loops, and avoiding unnecessary allocations.
Test the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as H=1, W=1, all-zero grid, all-one grid, and maximum W.
